title: Separated representable maps of fibred groupoids
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $f:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ be a morphism of categories over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, with the fibred-groupoid, morphism and $2$-base-change conventions of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Say $f$ is separated and representable by algebraic spaces if for every $S$-scheme $T$ and map $t:h_T\to\mathcal G$, the $2$-fibre product $h_T\times_{\mathcal G}\mathcal F$ has an algebraic-space presentation $Z$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] with its actual projection $p:Z\to h_T$, and this projection is separated in the presheaf-diagonal sense of [def-sfb-presheaf-map-separated-diagonal]. The presentation equivalence commutes with the projections up to a $2$-isomorphism over $T$. No stack condition or atlas is imposed by this predicate.
